resolution: (a) ludwigii+cloacae and (b) ludwigii with the 288-tip group (cloacae outside) carry 71-84% of resolved core genes with asburiae or kobei as the 288-group lineage and any in-genus reference; (a) larger with the four nearer references (40-53% v 32-40%), near-even with the two farthest (33-37% v 38%); the marker placement (ludwigii outside) takes 16-29% there and never leads in any of 18 quartets (smallest in 16; with sichuanensis and the two farthest references (lud, clo) is smallest, 29-31%, where sichuanensis carries cloacae-like tracts); no likelihood test of the marker placement with in-genus lineages exists (the C12x AU formerly cited, dlnL 1444.8 p-AU 1.5e-4, constrained ludwigii outside every sampled Enterobacter lineage, not inside the 402-tip clade); on the C12x panel the ML trees (pos12 and all positions) carry (lud, clo) and its branch has likelihood sCF 40.2 v 27.6/32.2, one alternative being the marker placement

question: E. sichuanensis (GCA_002939185.1) with E. chinensis (GCA_034008295.1) (distance methods) or with the cloacae pair, chinensis with asburiae/dykesii (BAC120 FastTree)
set22_outcome: distance right, marker misled (second history measured)
resolution: sichuanensis and chinensis are each other's closest named lineages: 65.7-79% of resolved core genes against cloacae, 0.53-0.62 of informative sites at each codon position, gCF 36.3 (alternatives 2.6/7.7), sCF 43.6; the core ML carries it on both panels at both codon schemes; a second tract-organised history, chinensis with asburiae/dykesii, is 24-39% of genes in {sich, chin, asb}

explanation: BAC120 markers sit disproportionately in cloacae-like tracts (25.2% of marker-carrying core genes favour sich+clo over sich+chin v 11.1% of other core genes, Fisher p = 1.8e-5, descriptive because tract-organised genes are not independent; 5 of 7 markers of the rpoBC/rplKAJL block), bringing the marker signal to near-even (114 v 98 sites); on that signal FastTree reproduces (sich, clo) on two of six focused samples (the C2 and C12x subsets) and IQ-TREE on none of the four it finished; the marker tree's chinensis+asburiae/dykesii is the minority history
